import html from typing import List # Example template; in real use this would be defined elsewhere. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Author: {writer_name}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(writer_name: str, title: str, body: str, tag_list: List[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- writer_name : str Name of the post's author. title : str Post headline. body : str Main text content of the post. tag_list : List[str] Collection of tags related to the post. Returns ------- str HTML string with placeholders replaced by escaped content. """ # Escape user‑supplied text to prevent XSS safe_writer = html.escape(writer_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) # Body may contain line breaks; escape but preserve them as
safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Build tags; each tag is wrapped in a safe_tags = "".join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_list ) # Populate the template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( writer_name=safe_writer, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags )
